verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform, so offering scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents API keys, tokens, or permission scopes. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Data-room 'who gets access' controls are an adjacent human file-sharing feature, not agent API credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
